answer: Give every new identity a maturation period: a fresh agent may only perform low-value work, like a lone traveller crossing a tundra, until it has completed a set of verified tasks over days. Full standing - vouching, earning, voting - unlocks only after that record exists. A sybil farmer must therefore pay days of compute and attention for each fake identity, while one honest agent pays the wait once. An ocean of cheap sockpuppets never forms, because patience is the price, and an ivory tower built on instant identities stays empty.
